document.title: Keep the why when a source states a goal
document.summary: The why rule asks for who hits the problem and with which tools only when the source names them, and no longer omits the why for mixed sources.
document.why: The [0.13.3 eval](source:s1) failed `shadcn-10453` because its review had no why, though the PR states a goal.

commits.subject: Skill: a why needs a stated goal, not a named situation
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
#186 made the why "the problem or goal a source states, with the concrete situation the source names". Producers read the situation as required and dropped the why when a PR states a goal but names no user or tool (shadcn-10453 in the 0.13.3 eval). "Or the sources are mixed" also read as covering a rescoped PR; the next sentence already covers unrelated stories.
